an9.25:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno paññāya cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti, tassetaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhuno kallaṃ vacanāya
an9.25:1.2: ‘khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātī’ ti.
an9.25:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhuno paññāya cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti.
an9.25:2.2: vītarāgaṃ me cittanti paññāya cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti.
an9.25:2.3: vītadosaṃ me cittanti paññāya cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti,
an9.25:2.4: vītamohaṃ me cittanti paññāya cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti.
an9.25:2.5: asārāgadhammaṃ me cittanti paññāya cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti.
an9.25:2.6: asandosadhammaṃ me cittanti paññāya cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti.
an9.25:2.7: asammohadhammaṃ me cittanti paññāya cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti
an9.25:2.8: anāvattidhammaṃ me cittaṃ kāmabhavāyāti paññāya cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti
an9.25:2.9: anāvattidhammaṃ me cittaṃ rūpabhavāyāti paññāya cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti.
an9.25:2.10: anāvattidhammaṃ me cittaṃ arūpabhavāyāti paññāya cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti.
an9.25:2.11: yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno paññāya cittaṃ suparicitaṃ hoti, tassetaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno kallaṃ vacanāya
an9.25:2.12: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānāmīti.
